title: 30 Claude plugins kaam ke hisaab se
content:
GitHub pe 30 best Claude plugins hain.
Maine unhe kaam ke hisaab se sort kiya hai.
Apni role dekho.

Agar code likhte ho, pehli row lo.
Claude senior dev ki tarah kaam karta hai.
Superpowers.
Matt Pocock skills.
ECC.
Karpathy skills.
Ponytail.
Aur Agent Skills.

Agar research karte ho, ya kuch bada samajhna hai.
Graphify.
Agent Reach.
Understand Anything.
Last 30 Days.
Career Ops.
Aur REA.

Agar projects bahut bade hain, aur tokens khatam ho jaate hain.
G-Stack.
Caveman.
Claude Mem.
Headroom.
GSD.
Aur BMAD Method.

Design aur visuals ke liye.
UI UX Pro Max.
Taste.
Archify.
Impeccable.
PPT Master.
Aur Diagram Design.

Likhne aur video ke liye.
Skills by Anthropic.
OpenMontage.
Hyperframes.
Humanizer.
I Have ADHD.
Aur Marketing Skills.

Saare 30 mat lagana.
Claude mein shor bhar jaata hai.
Apne hafte ke hisaab se ek row chuno.
Usme se ek plugin lagao.
Pehle repo khol kar dekho, woh tumhare computer pe kya chalane ki ijazat maangta hai.

Comment karo, plugins.
Main saare 30 links bhej dunga.
